reading.title: AI app ads promoting 'objectification of women' banned by watchdog
reading.summary: The ad regulator said it had "zero-tolerance" for ads promoting AI tools that could sexualise or objectify women.

news.title: 'Enough is enough': Women protest after string of murders near Johannesburg
news.summary: The police have since set up a task team to investigate the murders and have urged women in the Kempton Park area to avoid walking or running alone "particularly in isolated areas".
